CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE PUBLIC.FACT_SALES_ORDER_LSEG AS

WITH ORDER_TOTALS AS (
    SELECT
        ORDER_ID,
        SUM(
            TRY_CAST(QTY AS DECIMAL(18,2))
            * TRY_CAST(UNIT_PRICE AS DECIMAL(18,2))
            - TRY_CAST(DISCOUNT AS DECIMAL(18,2))
        ) AS ORDER_TOTAL_AMOUNT
    FROM RAW_ORDER_ITEMS
    GROUP BY ORDER_ID
)

SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY O.ORDER_ID) AS ORDER_SK,
    O.ORDER_ID,
    O.CUSTOMER_ID,
    TO_DATE(O.ORDER_DATE) AS ORDER_DATE,
    O.STATUS,
    O.CHANNEL,
    ROUND(T.ORDER_TOTAL_AMOUNT, 2) AS ORDER_TOTAL_AMOUNT
FROM RAW_ORDERS O
INNER JOIN ORDER_TOTALS T
    ON O.ORDER_ID = T.ORDER_ID
WHERE UPPER(TRIM(O.STATUS)) <> 'CANCELLED';"},"className":"com.datagaps.dataflow.models.SQLComponent","executionOption":"allparentpassorfail","excludeNotification":"N"},{"partitionOptions":{"partitionType":"","name":""},"easyQueryDefJson":{"sqlQuery":""},"failComponentWhenDatasetEmpty":"N","componentId":6,"componentName":"curated_to_aggrerated_transformation","tableName":"curated_to_aggrerated_transformation","category":"Processor","componentType":"SQL","rank":0,"dataSourceName":"","displayRows":50,"dependencies":[3],"options":{"dbTable":"SELECT
    ORDER_DATE AS SALES_DATE,
    CHANNEL,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ORDER_ID) AS ORDER_COUNT,
    ROUND(SUM(ORDER_TOTAL_AMOUNT), 2) AS TOTAL_SALES_AMOUNT,
    ROUND(AVG(ORDER_TOTAL_AMOUNT), 2) AS AVG_ORDER_VALUE
FROM FACT_SALES_ORDER
GROUP BY
    ORDER_DATE,
    CHANNEL;
"},"className":"com.datagaps.dataflow.models.SQLComponent","executionOption":"allparentpassorfail","excludeNotification":"N"},{"parallelRuns":5,"onlyInA":"Y","onlyInB":"Y","difference":"Y","enableTrim":"N","replaceNull":"N","autoDataTypeConversion":"Y","columnDifferencesCount":"Y","ignoreCase":"N","hasDuplicates":"N","onlyInAThresholdUnit":"number","onlyInAThreshold":0.0,"onlyInBThresholdUnit":"number","onlyInBThreshold":0.0,"differencesSourceThresholdUnit":"number","differencesSourceThreshold":0.0,"differencesTargetThresholdUnit":"number","differencesTargetThreshold":0.0,"passIfEmpty":"N","hideDatasets":"N","isRuntimeColumnMappingEnabled":"N","failComponentWhenBothDatasetsEmpty":"N","componentId":7,"componentName":"Multiple
